title: 41st sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/41/2024).

Question time: Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim asks the Minister of Homeland Security and Technology, Ali Ihusan, whether the police and customs have a sound system, or any regulation, for managing money seized and held during investigations.
First reading of the Bill amending the Anti-Corruption Commission Act (Law No. 13/2008), submitted on behalf of the government by Felidhoo MP Adam Zahir.
First reading of the Bill amending the Elections Commission Act (Law No. 8/2008), submitted on behalf of the government by Kelaa MP Abdulla Shareef.
Preliminary debate on the Bill amending the Tobacco Control Act (Law No. 15/2010), submitted on behalf of the government by Henveiru North MP Ahmed Aifan.
Foreign Relations Committee report on the President's nominee for Ambassador of the Maldives to the Republic of India.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting questioned the home minister on seized money, introduced bills on the Anti-Corruption and Elections Commissions, debated the Tobacco Control Act amendment, and took up a report on the ambassador to India.
